newsitem.title: USA: Continental adds Fla. and Panama flights.
newsitem.headline: Continental adds Fla. and Panama flights.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said on Friday that it will increase flights between New York and Florida to 49 a day between December and March.

The carrier said it is now flying 42 flights a day on those routes and plans to add more flights to Tampa, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach, Orlando and Fort Myers from its Newark hub for winter travel.
On Sunday, the carrier begins daily nonstop service from Newark to Panama City, Panama, where it plans to add a flight to Guayaquil, Ecuador within the next few weeks.
Continental said it is offering the flight for a $99 one-way introductory fare for travel before December 15, along with a $119 one-way fare offer to Guayaquil.
Tickets at the special fares must be bought by November 15.
